html:
Bathroom window tint is ideal for adding privacy to your home. Our bathroom window privacy film is not only great for privacy but you can customise your bathroom window decals with a design that ties in with your bathroom aesthetic or adds a touch of style & sophistication. Below is more information on our bathroom window decals.

Tint a Home offers a range of high-quality home window tinting films and is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network.

  • All our installations are done by professionally trained installers
  • We offer a lifetime warranty for residential applications
  • Our films are exclusive to us and are government certified by ARPANSA

Keep reading to find out more about our bathroom window decals.

Bathroom Window Decal Options

Bathroom window frosting film enables you to have ultimate privacy for your bathroom but still lets in natural light. And, you don’t just have to tint your bathroom window either, our bathroom window frosting film or custom-designed film can also be installed on shower screens or other glass walls to create a feature or to act as a divider.

If you are planning on installing window tint throughout your home, you can use a standard film for windows in other rooms, security film for areas that may be susceptible to break-ins and bathroom window privacy film in your bathroom. Our team will work with you to determine the best solution for your home and will be able to provide you with a quote. We also offer films in a lighter shade if you don’t want to alter the appearance of the windows throughout the rest of your home.

Get A Quote For Bathroom Window Decals Today

Use our Store Finder to contact your nearest store or call 13 TINT to get a quote for bathroom window decals. If you have any questions our customer service team are here to help.
